_parser_fn_note: Same reasoning as black-myth-wukong.json: the Benchmark Tool variant shares _parse_black_myth/_write_black_myth_ini with the retail game but passes benchmark=True, which changes several mappings (upscaling has no FSR3/NXSR, quick_preset has an extra Custom code, frame_generation 'On' instead of 'Auto', borderless-window resolution derivation). Kept as its own profile (not folded into black-myth-wukong.json) because Profile.matches() is an exact title match and the two games are genuinely different Steam apps with different installs/saves — see tests/test_profile_black_myth.py::test_benchmark_variant_not_hijacked_by_profile, which guarded this exact-match behavior before this profile existed.
